answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy managing harbor jetty traffic or auditing synthetic ivory trades enforces verifiable delay functions. Each agent must evaluate an unparallelizable sequential puzzle, exposing frictionless identity creation as a fable. An attacker incurs the scarce cost of non-preemptible wall-clock compute time per persona.
